data.description: An ideal sanctuary crafted for families within the heart of The Valley.

data.answer: Living in Talia The Valley offers families a perfect blend of an active lifestyle and serene surroundings. From green pocket parks to lush sikkas, the sub-community provides an idyllic haven where residents can enjoy the best of modern community living. Designed to meet the needs of families, this vibrant neighborhood places essential amenities and exclusive features right at your doorstep.

Talia The Valley homes for sale feature a variety of thoughtfully designed townhouses in 3 and 4-bedroom configurations, offering options that cater to diverse preferences. Each home is crafted with attention to detail and is available in three distinctive architectural styles: Pharo, Cyrus, and Elio, all seamlessly blending luxury and functionality.

The Pharo style stands out with its bold tones, sleek lines, and wooden accents, creating a contemporary aesthetic. Large windows flood the interiors with natural light and fresh air, while connections to pocket parks and green spaces enhance the outdoor living experience.

For those who appreciate minimalism and elegance, the Cyrus townhouses offer a perfect mix of simplicity and luxury, complemented by verdant surroundings and garden views from expansive windows. 

Meanwhile, the Elio homes are a testament to sophistication, featuring large windows that invite sunlight and frame lush garden vistas, making these residences an ideal choice for modern families. 

Buying a Property in Talia

The sub-community offers a flexible and attractive payment plan, making it easier for families and investors to own a home in this exceptional community. With 60% payable during construction and the remaining 40% due upon handover, the payment structure is designed to provide convenience and financial ease.

Starting at an estimated price of AED 1.45M, these townhouses represent an excellent opportunity to invest in Talia Dubai real estate. This vibrant development not only offers contemporary homes in a serene setting but also ensures seamless payment options for buyers seeking luxury, value, and connectivity in one of Dubai’s most promising communities.

Life here is a harmonious blend of modern living and natural tranquility, surrounded by lush green spaces and family-friendly amenities. With its serene environment, vibrant community, and thoughtfully designed homes, Talia offers the perfect setting for an active and fulfilling lifestyle.

Parking Spaces in Talia

Residents enjoy the convenience of private garages attached to each townhouse, along with ample visitor parking spaces thoughtfully distributed throughout the neighborhood, ensuring a hassle-free experience for both homeowners and their guests.

Shopping Mall Near Talia

While Talia is still developing as part of The Valley, residents will have access to a 32,000 sq. m Town Centre within the master community. This vibrant hub will feature retail outlets, dining options, and recreational spaces, providing a convenient shopping and leisure destination just minutes from home.

Schools and Nurseries Near Talia

Education is a key aspect of the family-friendly lifestyle offered by Talia The Valley amenities. Within the master community, residents will find Maple Bear Nursery. For older children, Vernus International School, offering an American curriculum, is just a 20-minute drive away, ensuring quality educational options are conveniently accessible for families.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Talia

For medical care, residents can access nearby facilities such as Dubai London Clinic and HealthHub Clinic, both located just a short drive away. These trusted healthcare providers ensure that quality medical services are easily accessible.

Location & Nearby Areas

It is located within the master community the Valley in Dubailand. The nearby areas accessible within a short drive are DAMAC Hills 2 and Academic City.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Talia, The Valley

data.answer:
Explore lush green spaces and pocket parks, perfect for outdoor activities and family gatherings in Talia, The Valley. Residents can also enjoy state-of-the-art sports facilities, picnic areas, and a vibrant Town Centre for shopping and leisure.

Beaches Near Talia

One of the standout features near Talia at The Valley is the 30,000 sq. m Golden Beach, located within the master community. This expansive beach area offers residents a serene escape with opportunities for relaxation, family picnics, and water-based activities, all just a short distance from home.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Emaar’s Talia at The Valley is a thoughtfully planned community designed for seamless living. Residents can enjoy easy access to key amenities such as the expansive Golden Beach and the vibrant Town Centre. Just steps away are the Sports Village, Kids’ Dale, and The Pavilion, offering a range of recreational and leisure activities. This makes Talia the perfect choice for families seeking an active and healthy lifestyle with all essentials conveniently close by.

Community Events

Talia at The Valley fosters a vibrant community spirit by hosting regular events such as farmers' markets, outdoor movie nights, and seasonal festivals, providing residents with opportunities to connect and engage.

Attractions and Landmarks

Talia at The Valley is perfectly positioned to offer residents easy access to prominent attractions and landmarks. Just 5 minutes away is the Al Marmoom Heritage Village, where visitors can explore the rich cultural heritage and traditions of the UAE. 

Additionally, The Villa community is only a 15-minute drive, providing access to a range of modern amenities and services. This prime location combines cultural immersion with contemporary conveniences, enhancing the lifestyle experience for Talia’s residents.

When living in Talia, residents can enjoy a serene lifestyle surrounded by nature, with convenient access to modern amenities and recreational facilities. Its strategic location ensures seamless connectivity to key destinations across Dubai.

What types of properties are available in Talia, The Valley?

Talia offers 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses in three distinct architectural styles: Pharo, Cyrus, and Elio.

When is the expected completion date for Talia, The Valley?

The project is estimated to be completed by the first quarter of 2025.

What amenities are available to residents of Talia?

Residents have access to a range of amenities, including pocket parks, natural open spaces, outdoor seating areas, barbecue and picnic areas, playgrounds, outdoor and indoor sports facilities, and retail and dining options.

Where is Talia located within Dubai?

Talia is situated within The Valley community, close to Dubai – Al Ain Road, providing easy access to major highways and key areas of the city. 

What is the payment plan for purchasing a property in Talia?

The payment plan typically involves 60% payable during construction and the remaining 40% due upon handover.

data.content:
Nestled within the serene landscapes of The Valley Dubai, Talia is an upcoming off-plan community by Emaar Properties, designed to redefine modern living with its lush greenery and family-oriented amenities. Scheduled for completion in the first quarter of 2025, this thoughtfully planned neighborhood offers residents a harmonious blend of nature and urban convenience.

This Talia The Valley area guide highlights its position as the third development within the master development. It features elegant 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses in three distinct contemporary designs. These homes are seamlessly integrated into the natural surroundings, creating a lifestyle that prioritizes tranquility and connection. Located conveniently close to Dubai – Al Ain Road, Talia ensures effortless connectivity to the city's vibrant hubs while offering a peaceful retreat.

Wondering what makes Talia The Valley unique? It's the holistic approach to community living. From scenic green spaces to family-centric facilities, the neighborhood brings together thoughtfully designed homes and amenities to foster a sense of belonging.
